examples.en: The children built a snowman in the front yard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在前院堆了一個雪人。

examples.en: We gave the snowman a red scarf and two buttons for eyes.
examples.zh: 我們給雪人圍上紅色圍巾，還用兩顆鈕扣當眼睛。

examples.en: The snowman began to melt when the sun came out.
examples.zh: 太陽出來後，雪人開始融化了。

examples.en: Our school has a strong softball team this year.
examples.zh: 我們學校今年有一支很強的壘球隊。

examples.en: She plays softball with her classmates every Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她每週五下午都和同學打壘球。

examples.en: He caught the softball and threw it to second base.
examples.zh: 他接住壘球，然後把球傳給二壘。

senses.zh: 他們的；她們的；牠們的（東西）

examples.en: Our house is small, but theirs is much bigger.
examples.zh: 我們的房子很小，但他們的大多了。

examples.en: I forgot my umbrella, so I borrowed theirs.
examples.zh: 我忘了帶傘，所以借了他們的。

examples.en: Is this table ours or theirs?
examples.zh: 這張桌子是我們的還是他們的？

senses.zh: 被接受的；公認的；普遍認可的

examples.en: Credit cards are an accepted form of payment here.
examples.zh: 在這裡，信用卡是被接受的付款方式。

examples.en: It is an accepted rule that students must wear uniforms.
examples.zh: 學生必須穿制服是公認的規定。

examples.en: The accepted answer to the question is on page ten.
examples.zh: 這個問題的公認答案在第十頁。

examples.en: Winning the science contest was a great achievement for her.
examples.zh: 贏得科學競賽對她來說是很大的成就。

examples.en: The achievement of our goal took three years of hard work.
examples.zh: 我們花了三年的努力才達成目標。

examples.en: His school achievement improved after he started studying every night.
examples.zh: 他開始每晚讀書後，在校成績進步了。

examples.en: An adjective describes a noun, such as big or happy.
examples.zh: 形容詞用來描述名詞，例如 big 或 happy。

examples.en: Please underline the adjective in each sentence.
examples.zh: 請在每個句子中把形容詞畫上底線。

examples.en: The word quick is an adjective in this sentence.
examples.zh: 在這個句子中，quick 這個字是形容詞。

examples.en: My aged grandfather still walks in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我年邁的祖父每天早上仍在公園散步。

examples.en: The club is open to children aged ten to twelve.
examples.zh: 這個社團開放給十到十二歲的孩子。

examples.en: This shop sells aged cheese from several countries.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自多個國家的陳年起司。

examples.en: The two companies signed an agreement last week.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司上週簽了一份協議。

examples.en: We reached an agreement about where to go for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們就旅行要去哪裡達成了共識。

examples.en: There is no agreement among the students about the party date.
examples.zh: 學生們對派對日期沒有共識。

examples.en: The air-conditioned library is a cool place to study in summer.
examples.zh: 有冷氣的圖書館是夏天讀書的涼爽好地方。

examples.en: We stayed in an air-conditioned room during the heat wave.
examples.zh: 熱浪來襲時，我們待在有冷氣的房間裡。

examples.en: Is the bus air-conditioned, or should I bring a fan?
examples.zh: 這輛公車有冷氣嗎？還是我該帶一把扇子？

examples.en: Please send the package by airmail so it arrives sooner.
examples.zh: 請用航空郵寄這個包裹，這樣會比較快到。

examples.en: The airmail from Japan arrived in only four days.
examples.zh: 從日本寄來的航空郵件只花了四天就到了。

examples.en: She put an airmail sticker on the envelope.
examples.zh: 她在信封上貼了一張航空郵件標籤。

examples.en: Soda cans are usually made of aluminium.
examples.zh: 汽水罐通常是用鋁做的。

examples.en: Aluminium is light, so it is used to make airplanes.
examples.zh: 鋁很輕，所以被用來製造飛機。

examples.en: Please put the used aluminium in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請把用過的鋁製品放進回收桶。

examples.en: The clown made the children laugh with amusement.
examples.zh: 小丑逗得孩子們開心大笑。

examples.en: Our family went to the amusement park on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們全家星期日去了遊樂園。

examples.en: He read comic books for amusement during the long trip.
examples.zh: 漫長的旅途中，他看漫畫書來消遣。

examples.en: The principal made an announcement about the school trip.
examples.zh: 校長宣布了關於校外教學的事。

examples.en: Please listen to the announcement at the train station.
examples.zh: 請注意聽車站的廣播通知。

examples.en: The company will make a big announcement next Monday.
examples.zh: 公司下週一將發布一項重要消息。

examples.en: The radio announcer read the weather report at seven.
examples.zh: 廣播員在七點播報了天氣預報。

examples.en: A stadium announcer told the crowd about the schedule change.
examples.zh: 體育場的播報員向群眾說明了時間表的更動。

examples.en: My uncle works as a TV announcer in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在臺北擔任電視播報員。

examples.en: I downloaded a new app to learn English words.
examples.zh: 我下載了一個新的應用程式來學英文單字。

examples.en: This app shows when the next bus will arrive.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式會顯示下一班公車何時到。

examples.en: Many students use a study app on their tablets.
examples.zh: 很多學生會在平板電腦上使用學習應用程式。

examples.en: I have a dentist appointment at three o'clock.
examples.zh: 我三點有牙醫的預約。

examples.en: Please make an appointment before you visit the office.
examples.zh: 來辦公室之前，請先預約。

examples.en: The appointment of the new manager was announced yesterday.
examples.zh: 新任經理的任命昨天公布了。

examples.en: My brother and I had an argument about the TV.
examples.zh: 我哥哥和我為了電視吵了一架。

examples.en: Her argument for a longer lunch break was very clear.
examples.zh: 她主張延長午休時間的論點非常清楚。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to support each argument with facts.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們用事實來支持每一個論點。

examples.en: We made an arrangement to meet at the station at noon.
examples.zh: 我們約好中午在車站碰面。

examples.en: The flower arrangement on the table looks beautiful.
examples.zh: 桌上的插花擺設看起來很漂亮。

examples.en: Travel arrangements for the school trip are almost complete.
examples.zh: 校外教學的行程安排差不多完成了。

examples.en: The hospital has an auxiliary power system for emergencies.
examples.zh: 醫院有一套緊急時使用的備用電力系統。

examples.en: An auxiliary verb such as do or have helps the main verb.
examples.zh: 像 do 或 have 這樣的助動詞可以輔助主要動詞。

examples.en: The school added auxiliary classrooms for the new students.
examples.zh: 學校為新生增設了附屬教室。

examples.en: He used an ax to cut the firewood.
examples.zh: 他用斧頭劈柴。

examples.en: The camper kept a sharp ax in his backpack.
examples.zh: 那位露營者的背包裡放著一把鋒利的斧頭。

examples.en: Please put the ax back in the garage after you finish.
examples.zh: 用完之後，請把斧頭放回車庫。

examples.en: The city plans to ax the old bus route next year.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫明年裁撤那條老公車路線。

examples.en: The company decided to ax two hundred jobs to save money.
examples.zh: 公司決定削減兩百個職缺來節省開支。

examples.en: The TV station axed the show after only one season.
examples.zh: 電視臺只播了一季就把那個節目砍掉了。

examples.en: He likes to wear baggy jeans and a big sweater.
examples.zh: 他喜歡穿寬鬆的牛仔褲和大毛衣。

examples.en: My old T-shirt is baggy after many washes.
examples.zh: 我的舊T恤洗了很多次後變得鬆垮垮的。

examples.en: The baggy coat kept her warm on the cold morning.
examples.zh: 那件寬鬆的外套讓她在寒冷的早晨很溫暖。

examples.en: Can you put a band-aid on my knee?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我的膝蓋貼一片OK繃嗎？

examples.en: She keeps a box of band-aid in her school bag.
examples.zh: 她的書包裡放著一盒OK繃。

examples.en: The nurse covered the cut with a small band-aid.
examples.zh: 護理師用一片小OK繃蓋住了傷口。

examples.en: My aunt has worked in banking for ten years.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在銀行業工作了十年。

examples.en: Online banking makes it easy to pay bills at home.
examples.zh: 網路銀行讓在家繳帳單變得很容易。

examples.en: The bank offers banking services from eight to five.
examples.zh: 這間銀行從八點到五點提供銀行業務服務。

examples.en: My dad gets a haircut at the barbershop every month.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每個月都去理髮店剪頭髮。

examples.en: There is a small barbershop next to the bookstore.
examples.zh: 書店旁邊有一家小小的理髮店。

examples.en: We waited at the barbershop until it was our turn.
examples.zh: 我們在理髮店等到輪到我們為止。

examples.en: The ancient temple was built around 500 bc.
examples.zh: 這座古老的神殿大約建於西元前五百年。

examples.en: Our history teacher said the city was founded in 753 bc.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師說這座城市建立於西元前七五三年。

examples.en: The museum has coins that date back to 300 bc.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有可追溯到西元前三百年的錢幣。

examples.en: The bird carried a worm in its beak.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥的嘴裡叼著一條蟲。

examples.en: An eagle has a strong, curved beak.
examples.zh: 老鷹有一個強而有力的彎曲鳥喙。

examples.en: The baby duck opened its small beak to ask for food.
examples.zh: 小鴨張開小小的嘴巴討食物吃。

examples.en: Bedtime for the kids is nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 孩子們的就寢時間是九點。

examples.en: Mom reads a story to my little sister at bedtime.
examples.zh: 媽媽在睡前讀故事給我妹妹聽。

examples.en: It is almost bedtime, so please turn off the TV.
examples.zh: 快到就寢時間了，請把電視關掉。

examples.en: His excuse for being late was not believable.
examples.zh: 他遲到的藉口不太可信。

examples.en: The actor made the character very believable.
examples.zh: 那位演員讓這個角色顯得非常真實可信。

examples.en: It is hard to find a believable answer to this question.
examples.zh: 很難為這個問題找到令人信服的答案。

examples.en: The baby laughed and patted his round belly.
examples.zh: 寶寶笑著拍拍他圓圓的肚子。

examples.en: I have a pain in my belly after eating too fast.
examples.zh: 我吃得太快，現在肚子痛。

examples.en: The cat lay on its back to show its soft belly.
examples.zh: 那隻貓仰躺著，露出柔軟的肚子。

examples.en: She keeps a small bible beside her bed.
examples.zh: 她在床邊放了一本小小的聖經。

examples.en: This bible has been translated into many languages.
examples.zh: 這本聖經已被翻譯成許多種語言。

examples.en: That cookbook is the bible for every beginner in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 那本食譜是每位廚房新手的權威指南。

examples.en: We played bingo at the class party.
examples.zh: 我們在班上的派對玩了賓果遊戲。

examples.en: Grandma goes to a bingo game every Thursday night.
examples.zh: 奶奶每個星期四晚上都去玩賓果。

examples.en: He needs only one more number to win at bingo.
examples.zh: 他只差一個號碼就能在賓果遊戲中獲勝。

examples.en: Bingo! That is the answer I was looking for.
examples.zh: 答對了！這正是我在找的答案。

examples.en: You guessed my age? Bingo!
examples.zh: 你猜中我的年紀了？沒錯！

examples.en: Bingo, we found the missing key under the sofa.
examples.zh: 找到了，我們在沙發底下找到了不見的鑰匙。

examples.en: The little girl has blonde hair and blue eyes.
examples.zh: 那個小女孩有一頭金髮和一雙藍眼睛。

examples.en: He dyed his hair blonde for the school play.
examples.zh: 他為了學校的話劇把頭髮染成金色。

examples.en: My sister was blonde as a child, but her hair turned brown.
examples.zh: 我姊姊小時候是金髮，後來頭髮變成了棕色。

examples.en: The stray dog was thin and bony.
examples.zh: 那隻流浪狗又瘦又骨瘦如柴。

examples.en: He has long, bony fingers that are good for playing the piano.
examples.zh: 他有一雙適合彈鋼琴的細長瘦骨手指。

examples.en: This fish is too bony for small children to eat.
examples.zh: 這種魚刺太多，小孩子不適合吃。

examples.en: I made a hotel booking for our trip to Tainan.
examples.zh: 我為我們的臺南之旅訂了旅館。

examples.en: The restaurant is full, so we need an early booking.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳客滿，所以我們得提早預訂。

examples.en: Please check your booking details in the email.
examples.zh: 請查看電子郵件中的預訂資料。

examples.en: There is a tall bookshelf next to my desk.
examples.zh: 我的書桌旁邊有一個高高的書架。

examples.en: She put the new dictionary on the top shelf of the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 她把新字典放在書架的最上層。

examples.en: Dad built a wooden bookshelf for the living room.
examples.zh: 爸爸為客廳做了一個木頭書櫃。

examples.en: Her boyfriend gave her flowers on her birthday.
examples.zh: 她的男朋友在她生日那天送了她花。

examples.en: My sister is going to a movie with her boyfriend.
examples.zh: 我姊姊要和她的男朋友去看電影。

examples.en: Have you met Anna's new boyfriend yet?
examples.zh: 你見過安娜的新男朋友了嗎？

examples.en: She bought a new bra at the department store.
examples.zh: 她在百貨公司買了一件新胸罩。

examples.en: Please wash the bra by hand to keep its shape.
examples.zh: 請用手洗胸罩，才能維持它的形狀。

examples.en: The shop sells a sports bra in many sizes.
examples.zh: 這家店販售多種尺寸的運動內衣。

examples.en: He got a brand-new bike for his birthday.
examples.zh: 他生日時得到一輛全新的腳踏車。

examples.en: The school opened a brand-new gym last month.
examples.zh: 學校上個月啟用了一座全新的體育館。

examples.en: My phone is brand-new, so I don't want to drop it.
examples.zh: 我的手機是全新的，所以我不想摔到它。

examples.en: Mom baked a pan of brownie for the class party.
examples.zh: 媽媽為班級派對烤了一盤布朗尼。

examples.en: I ate a warm brownie with vanilla ice cream.
examples.zh: 我吃了一塊搭配香草冰淇淋的熱布朗尼。

examples.en: Would you like a brownie with your coffee?
examples.zh: 你想在咖啡之外再來一塊布朗尼嗎？

examples.en: Capitalism is an economic system based on private business.
examples.zh: 資本主義是以私人企業為基礎的經濟制度。

examples.en: The teacher explained how capitalism developed in Europe.
examples.zh: 老師說明了資本主義在歐洲是如何發展起來的。

examples.en: Many countries in the world follow a form of capitalism.
examples.zh: 世界上許多國家採行某種形式的資本主義。

examples.en: She looked through the furniture catalog for a new sofa.
examples.zh: 她翻閱家具型錄想找一張新沙發。

examples.en: The library catalog is on the computer near the door.
examples.zh: 圖書館的目錄在門邊的電腦上。

examples.en: The shop mails a new catalog to customers every spring.
examples.zh: 這家店每年春天都會寄新型錄給顧客。

examples.en: The librarian will catalog all the new books this week.
examples.zh: 圖書館員這週會為所有新書編目。

examples.en: Volunteers cataloged the old photos in the museum.
examples.zh: 志工為博物館裡的舊照片登記造冊。

examples.en: We need to catalog every item before the sale.
examples.zh: 拍賣前我們得把每件物品都登記造冊。

examples.en: The weather in spring is very changeable.
examples.zh: 春天的天氣非常多變。

examples.en: His mood is changeable, so it is hard to guess.
examples.zh: 他的心情多變，所以很難猜。

examples.en: The schedule is changeable if the teacher is busy.
examples.zh: 如果老師有事，這個時間表是可以更動的。

examples.en: Check-in at the hotel starts at three o'clock.
examples.zh: 旅館的入住登記從三點開始。

examples.en: The airline's check-in desk is on the second floor.
examples.zh: 航空公司的劃位櫃檯在二樓。

examples.en: Online check-in saves time before the flight.
examples.zh: 線上報到可以在搭機前節省時間。

examples.en: There was a long line at the checkout in the supermarket.
examples.zh: 超市的結帳櫃檯大排長龍。

examples.en: Checkout at the hotel is at eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 旅館的退房時間是十一點。

examples.en: Click the checkout button to pay for your order.
examples.zh: 請按結帳鈕來付款。

examples.en: The hen is watching over her little chicks.
examples.zh: 母雞照看著她的小雞們。

examples.en: A baby chick came out of the egg this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一隻小雞從蛋裡孵出來了。

examples.en: The children fed the chicks on the farm.
examples.zh: 孩子們在農場餵小雞。

examples.en: My aunt took a class to learn about childbirth.
examples.zh: 我阿姨去上了關於生產的課程。

examples.en: Childbirth can take many hours for a first-time mother.
examples.zh: 對第一次生產的媽媽來說，分娩可能要花很多個小時。

examples.en: The hospital has a special room for childbirth.
examples.zh: 這家醫院有專門的生產室。

examples.en: My neighbor is a Christian and goes to church every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居是基督徒，每個星期天都會去教會。

examples.en: The school was started by a group of Christians in 1950.
examples.zh: 這所學校是一群基督徒在一九五○年創辦的。

examples.en: Many Christians gather to celebrate on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 許多基督徒在平安夜聚會慶祝。

examples.en: They held a Christian wedding in a small chapel.
examples.zh: 他們在一間小教堂舉行了基督教婚禮。

examples.en: She attends a Christian school near her home.
examples.zh: 她就讀家附近的一所基督教學校。

examples.en: The Christian holiday of Easter is celebrated in spring.
examples.zh: 基督教的復活節在春天慶祝。

senses.zh: 登山者；攀岩者；攀緣植物

examples.en: The climber reached the top of the mountain at noon.
examples.zh: 那位登山者在中午抵達山頂。

examples.en: A young climber practiced on the wall at the gym.
examples.zh: 一位年輕的攀岩者在健身房的岩壁上練習。

examples.en: This climber grows quickly and covers the fence with green leaves.
examples.zh: 這種攀緣植物長得很快，會用綠葉覆蓋整道圍籬。

examples.en: She drew a picture with colored pencils.
examples.zh: 她用彩色鉛筆畫了一幅圖。

examples.en: The shop sells colored paper in many bright shades.
examples.zh: 這家店賣各種鮮豔顏色的彩色紙。

examples.en: The kids threw colored balloons into the air.
examples.zh: 孩子們把彩色氣球拋向空中。

examples.en: We are busy preparing for the coming holiday.
examples.zh: 我們正忙著為即將到來的假期做準備。

examples.en: The coming week will be full of exams.
examples.zh: 接下來這個星期考試會很多。

examples.en: I'm looking forward to the coming school year.
examples.zh: 我很期待即將到來的新學年。

examples.en: The coming of spring brings warm weather.
examples.zh: 春天的來臨帶來溫暖的天氣。

examples.en: Everyone was excited about the coming of the new teacher.
examples.zh: 大家對新老師的到來都很興奮。

examples.en: The farmers welcomed the coming of the rain.
examples.zh: 農夫們歡迎雨水的到來。
